QuestInfo.name: Dangerous Performance
QuestInfo.0: Ask Oliver about the Fantasy Crittertorium.
QuestInfo.1: Watch the two main attractions of the Fantasy Crittertorium, the Ursa Awesome Show and the Leaping Leo Revue, then tell Madame Ming what you thought.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Scarboss and Targa that appeared in the Fantasy Crittertorium.

0.0: The Fantasy Crittertorium is the crowning jewel of our beloved Fantasy Theme World. You really have to see it yourself. Do you want to go in now?

yes.0: All right! Have a great time and... take care of yourself. Hehehe...

no.0: Youl'l regret it if you miss it!

1.0: Did you enjoy the Fantasy Crittertorium show?

yes.0: Congratulations on making it through the shows, and have a wonderful time in Fantasy Theme World!

npc.0: Fantasy Crittertorium for the win! Go let Madame Ming know what you thought about shows!

mob.0: You haven't seen all of the show? Make sure you catch both shows, Scarboss and Targa!
